sources.title: xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google publishes compressed-tensors W4A16 QAT checkpoints for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B. Its QAT model card lists none for 26B-A4B, which ships as Q4_0 GGUF and as a 48 GiB bf16 export.

sources.title: GitHub - xbill9/tpu-jax-4b
sources.snippet: This repository is an experimental, inspectable inference path for google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-w4a16-ct on one Cloud TPU v6e-1. It loads the QAT checkpoint directly from safetensors, executes Gemma 4 in JAX without PyTorch, and exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP/SSE server.
